The paid classical quantitative PNT gives |C_psi|<=C L^-7 exp(L/2-c sqrt L) for L>=1. This is an unconditional signed-discrepancy baseline but remains exponential; it does not meet the polynomial lower-bound target.

The exact psi covariance uses ell_prime minus the complete finite continuous symbol. Physical derivatives commute with these translation operators, so no positive derivative commutator supplies the missing sign.
